name: Yuuichi Michimiya
source: Shiba Inu high school senior who, though stuck in a years-long rut of listlessness and lack of motivation, remains the male star of his school's tennis team and a very promising candidate for high-level professional play. However, when he is forced to confront just how much his grades and tennis skills have stagnated—or even deteriorated—over the past few years, he also realizes that, unlike those areas of his life, his relationships have steadily deepened and grown stronger. Encouraged by the support and belief of the people around him, he struggles to rediscover his A-game and finally live up to his potential during the last year of his high school career.
